enabled.title: Enable Streamer Punishments
enabled.description: Requires the Streamer Punishments Streamer.bot actions approved, and one OBS filter per screen effect.

effects.title: Screen effects
effects.description: Each row is one effect: its name, the OBS source it changes, the OBS filter StreamBridge turns on, how many seconds, the StreamBridge points price, and optional Twitch and Kick reward IDs in their own boxes.

exercises.title: Exercises
exercises.description: Each row is one exercise: its name, reps per purchase, the StreamBridge points price, and optional Twitch and Kick reward IDs in their own boxes.

buyCommand.title: Buy command
buyCommand.description: Viewers type !buy pushups. !buy on its own lists everything with its price.

buyPlatforms.title: Chats that can buy with StreamBridge points
buyPlatforms.description: Twitch and Kick use channel point rewards by default; tick them here to also allow !buy with StreamBridge points.

doneCommand.title: Done command (moderators and you)
doneCommand.description: Marks the exercise in progress as done, for example !done or !done pushups.

statusCommand.title: Totals command
statusCommand.description: Shows this month's reps and what is still owed.

controlCommand.title: Moderator control command
controlCommand.description: !punish off stops the current effect and puts the exercise back on the owed list; !punish clear clears owed exercises; !punish next starts the next one.

graceSeconds.title: Grace period before an exercise (seconds)
graceSeconds.description: A countdown shows on the overlay before StreamBridge switches scenes, so you can get somewhere safe in a game you cannot pause.

safeSceneName.title: Scene for exercises
safeSceneName.description: StreamBridge switches here when the grace period ends. Leave empty to stay on the current scene.

allowedScenes.title: Only on these scenes
allowedScenes.description: Punishments can be bought or redeemed only while one of these scenes is live. Leave empty for every scene. role:live, role:chatting and the other roles follow Scene roles. Bits, tips and gifts are never blocked.

returnToPreviousScene.title: Switch back when done
returnToPreviousScene.description: Returns to the scene you were on, unless you already moved away from the exercise scene.

maximumPerStream.title: Most purchases of each exercise per stream
maximumPerStream.description: 0 means no limit. Counts !buy and Kick rewards together. Twitch rewards use the limit set on the reward itself.

exerciseLimitPerStream.title: Most exercises per stream, all platforms together
exerciseLimitPerStream.description: 0 means no shared limit. Every exercise counts, whichever exercise it is and wherever it was bought: Twitch and Kick rewards and !buy on every platform.

exerciseCooldownMinutes.title: Cooldown for each exercise (minutes)
exerciseCooldownMinutes.description: Applies to !buy and Kick rewards. Twitch rewards use the cooldown set on the reward itself.

effectCooldownSeconds.title: Cooldown for each screen effect from Kick rewards (seconds)
effectCooldownSeconds.description: Kick rewards have no cooldown of their own. 0 means no cooldown.

maximumEffectQueue.title: Screen effects that can wait in line

onlyWhileLive.title: Only while live
onlyWhileLive.description: Moderators and you can still test while offline.

showOverlay.title: Show the countdown on the overlay
showOverlay.description: Uses this extension's overlay browser source.

trackerEnabled.title: Show the punishments tracker panel
trackerEnabled.description: A small panel on the overlay with what is owed and this month's totals. Add ?tracker=only to a second browser source to place it on its own.

trackerOnlyWhileOwed.title: Show the tracker only while something is owed
trackerOnlyWhileOwed.description: Hides the panel when no exercise or bean is owed or in progress. Turn off to keep it on screen all the time.

startMessage.title: Exercise starts message
startMessage.default: Time for {reps} {name} from {viewer}! A mod types !{done} when they are done.

limitMessage.title: Per-stream limit message
limitMessage.default: {viewer}, {name} is maxed out for this stream ({limit}). Try another punishment.

exercisesLeftMessage.title: Exercises left message
exercisesLeftMessage.description: Sent on the platform an exercise came from, after it is accepted. Placeholders: {remaining}, {used}, {limit}, {viewer}, {name}.

exercisesUsedUpMessage.title: No exercises left message
exercisesUsedUpMessage.default: No exercises left this stream ({used} of {limit} used).
exercisesUsedUpMessage.description: Sent when the shared limit is reached. !buy spends no points. On Twitch and Kick a note asks a mod to refund the channel points.

cooldownMessage.title: Cooldown message
cooldownMessage.default: {viewer}, {name} is cooling down. Try again in {minutes} min.

beanEnabled.title: Enable the Bean Boozled wheel
beanEnabled.description: Bits, TikTok gifts, and tips spin a wheel of bean colors, then reveal a nice or nasty flavor. The bean goes on the owed list like an exercise.

beanPairs.title: Beans
beanPairs.description: Each row is one bean color on the wheel: its color name, the wheel color, the nice flavor, and the nasty flavor. Up to 10 rows. Ships with the BeanBoozled 7th edition.
default: Yellow spotted | #e8c33a | Top Banana | Wet Dog
Pink | #f4a6c0 | Strawberry Banana Smoothie | Dead Fish

beanBitsPerSpin.title: Bits per spin
beanBitsPerSpin.description: Twitch bits needed for one spin. 0 turns bits off.

beanCoinsPerSpin.title: TikTok coins per spin
beanCoinsPerSpin.description: TikTok gift coins needed for one spin. Small gifts from the same viewer add up during the stream. 0 turns TikTok gifts off.

beanTipPerSpin.title: Tip per spin (whole currency units)
beanTipPerSpin.description: For example 5 means $5 per spin. 0 turns tips off.

beanTipCurrency.title: Tip currency
beanTipCurrency.description: Three-letter currency code. Tips in other currencies do not spin.

beanMaximumSpins.title: Most spins from one cheer, gift, or tip

beanSpinMessage.title: Bean result message
beanSpinMessage.default: {viewer} spun the Bean Boozled wheel and landed on {color}... it is {result}: {flavor}!
